svg.aria-label: A twin-lane coin feed on a bed. Tokens, one per call to lock(), stack in one column on pawls: the single queue. When a token is granted the pawls open and it drops into a sliding shuttle below, which carries it sideways to whichever of two lanes is free. Each lane has its own crank-driven pusher blade and its own press, so the two holders work and release independently.
svg.title: superlock semaphore
